tasks.do: SH-230, one shared rule in js/shared/onboard.js used by every game's onboarding light: the box is the union of the thing's picture, its word pill and its face icon (whichever it has), plus a margin of 12% of the union's smaller side, 8 to 16 px; on a side where that margin would touch a neighbouring item (the avoid list), it shrinks only as far as keeps 2 px clear of that item (was half the gap, down to 0); at the screen's edge it stops at the edge. Chai's shelf (itemRect, chai-tray.js:2219-2267) builds its union from the jar picture AND the pill (a speaker-only pill is narrower than its jar: the jar sets the sides). Every other game that lights a thing goes through the same rule (coach.js hugOf and others: find them with build/tools/review/kitmap.mjs).
